svg.aria-label: Seven concentric rings of progressively thinner weight on a deep navy field, with a solid Spaarke-blue disc at the center and a small copper-gold highlight on one of the inner rings.
svg.title: Institutional knowledge — accumulated layers
svg.desc: Seven concentric rings of varying line weight centered in the frame, the innermost a small solid disc in confident electric-blue, the next two rings in CTA-blue at decreasing weight, the outer four rings in muted slate at progressively thinner weight, with the outermost ring barely visible — visualizing institutional memory as accumulated, layered, durable context. A faint copper-gold highlight sits at one point on the second-innermost ring.
